newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade light $68 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade light $68 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow in the Panhandle
area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady.
Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers.

Sales reported on 2,800 slaughter steers and 900 slaughter heifers. 100,100 head confirmed for the week to date including 7 loads or 300 head of CME cattle delivered to area packing plants and 15,900 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs
Wk to Date - 100,100 Week Ago - 91,000 Year Ago - 121,800
